tracks.name: hol
tracks.description: Prove in HOL4 that submitted RISC-V bytes satisfy the fixed init-e Certificate for the software-precompile EVM guest within a step bound K, and minimize K. Submissions are HOL4 proof sources that the verifier builds and exports in a sandbox, then strictly replays. The initial submission claims infinity.
tracks.hardware: Official runs: blacksmith-32vcpu-ubuntu-2404 (128 GB RAM), directly on the runner; candidate proof scripts run only inside the verifier's Bubblewrap sandbox. Limits: 36,000 s and 64 GiB address space per author stage (build, export, bind, package), 21,600 s CPU and wall time and 112 GiB address space for strict replay, 75,600 s for the whole verifier. Upstream's accepted baseline run took 39,177 s (10 h 53 min) end to end, 13,128 s of it strict replay, with 90.25 GiB maximum RSS. Cold setup builds Poly/ML, two HOL4 trees and the baseline theories; official runs restore it from a cache saved on main.
